The '''Kilian Bantha''' was a subspecies of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kilia IV/Legends|Kilia IV]].

Standing up to three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall at the shoulder, Kilian banthas could easily traverse a steep, rocky slope, and were well-adapted to living in mountainous regions. Their fur was thicker and longer than a [[Bantha/Legends|common bantha's]], and their diet consisted of a wide spectrum of shrubs and other plant life. They were capable of going weeks without food or water in critical situations.

Kilian banthas were domesticated by the natives of [[Kilia IV/Legends|Kilia IV]] for use as mounts while traveling through the mountains. Like all species of bantha, the Kilian's were raised for their milk, meat, and hide.
